## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor security finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: [Sensitive Data Exposure] API keys expanded into curl -H headers make them readable via /proc/PID/cmdline on Linux during curl execution window. Current deployment uses GitHub-hosted runners (ephemeral isolated VMs), so exploitation risk is negligible. Defensive hardening via --config file pattern would improve portability to self-hosted runner environments.
File: plugins/dso/scripts/llm-api-call.sh
Category: correctness / security
data.title: [llm-api-call.sh]: API keys passed as curl argv headers -> readable via /proc/PID/cmdline on shared runners
